epic.title: GEO: Cookie Consent for Hubspot/PQL
epic.functionalNeed: Implement a cookies and cookie policy solution for the Measure module that reuses the existing banner and preferences UI, adheres to the same consent categories, and gates all non-essential cookies and analytics for Measure behind explicit user consent. This is a legal GDPR requirement for platforms operating in Europe.
scope: Reuse cross-application cookie banner and preferences UI from Review module
Three consent categories: Essential (always on), Support/Functional (opt-in, includes HubSpot/Intercom), Analytics (opt-in)
JIT consent bridge when users trigger features requiring non-essential cookies
Privacy fallback (no Consent Wall) for users who decline Functional cookies
HubSpot PQL upsell event tracking gated on Functional consent
Cookie inventory documented in Settings Grid
Upsell page content refresh to match Figma V2
outOfScope: Cross-subdomain cookie sharing with 360/Review (technically impossible at geo.onclusive.com scope)
ES, DE, IT translations (deferred — V1 is EN/FR only)
Intercom Messenger boot and wiring (GEO-243 scope)
Dual cookie write to onclusive:mention:cookie-consent (abandoned — see GEO-331)

stories.title: Story 17.1 — Consent State Provider + cc_cookie persistence (Zustand store + vanilla-cookieconsent integration)

userStory.want: a Zustand store that mirrors the user's cc_cookie consent state and a vanilla-cookieconsent v3 integration that persists changes back to the cookie
userStory.so: GEO has a single typed consent API consumed by all dependent epics (GEO-243 Intercom, GEO-244 FullStory, future HubSpot epic), with consent changes durably stored on geo.onclusive.com for 180 days

acceptanceCriteria.title: Boot with cc_cookie already present
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user lands on GEO with cc_cookie already set on geo.onclusive.com
acceptanceCriteria.then: useCookieConsentStore exposes hasRespondedToConsent === true, areAnalyticsCookiesEnabled and areFunctionalCookiesEnabled reflecting the parsed cookie payload, and no banner is shown (shouldShowBanner === false)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Boot without cc_cookie
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user lands on GEO with no cc_cookie
acceptanceCriteria.then: hasRespondedToConsent === false, shouldShowBanner === true

acceptanceCriteria.title: Commit consent
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user clicks Accept all / Essential only / saves Preferences
acceptanceCriteria.then: cc_cookie is written by vanilla-cookieconsent v3 with domain=current host, sameSite=lax, secure=true in prod/staging, TTL=180 days

acceptanceCriteria.title: Modify preferences from store
acceptanceCriteria.given: the user changes preferences from the GEO modal (Story 17.3)
acceptanceCriteria.when: Save is clicked and savePreferences({analytics, functional}) is called on the store
acceptanceCriteria.then: cookie is updated synchronously via lib API, BroadcastChannel('geo-consent') is notified, all subscribers receive the new state

acceptanceCriteria.title: Cross-tab sync
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user has consent stored on GEO and multiple GEO tabs open
acceptanceCriteria.when: another tab updates the consent cookie via BroadcastChannel or poller fallback detects a change
acceptanceCriteria.then: the store rehydrates on next render and all subscribers receive the new state

acceptanceCriteria.title: Malformed cookie payload
acceptanceCriteria.given: a malformed or version-mismatched cookie payload
acceptanceCriteria.when: the lib parser fails or the store detects an incoherent payload
acceptanceCriteria.then: store treats user as not yet consented, purges corrupt cookie, without throwing or breaking app boot

acceptanceCriteria.title: Dev mode fixture seeding
acceptanceCriteria.then: store can be seeded from a fixture object without a real cookie; tree-shaken in prod build

technicalNotes: cc_cookie scoped to geo.onclusive.com (geo.onclusive.com scope only — no cross-subdomain)

stories.title: Story 17.2 — Cookie Banner Phase 1 (vanilla-cookieconsent v3 React wrapper + initial UI)

userStory.as: first-time GEO user without prior consent on geo.onclusive.com
userStory.want: a clear cookie consent banner with Accept all / Essential only / Manage preferences options
userStory.so: I can make an informed GDPR-compliant choice before any non-essential script or cookie is loaded

acceptanceCriteria.title: Initial display without cc_cookie
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user lands on GEO with no cc_cookie set
acceptanceCriteria.then: cookie banner is rendered at the bottom of the viewport with title, description, and three CTAs

acceptanceCriteria.title: Accept all
acceptanceCriteria.then: cc_cookie written with categories=[necessary, analytics, functional_support], banner disappears

acceptanceCriteria.title: Essential only
acceptanceCriteria.then: cc_cookie written with categories=[necessary] only, banner disappears

acceptanceCriteria.title: Button styles (PM 2026-05-06)
acceptanceCriteria.given: buttons Manage preferences, Essential Only and Accept All are rendered
acceptanceCriteria.then: Manage preferences=Ghost primary (sky-700 text), Essential Only=Stroke neutral, Accept All=Filled primary (sky-700 bg). LEGAL RISK: abandons equalWeightButtons principle — PM derogation pending legal review.

technicalNotes: Option B: custom React wrapper CookieConsentBanner.tsx (lib autoShow:false)

stories.title: Story 17.3 — Cookie Preferences Modal (Settings Grid + per-category toggles + Save)

userStory.as: GEO user wanting fine-grained control over cookies
userStory.want: to open a Cookie Preferences modal that displays each cookie category with toggles, allowing me to enable/disable Functional and Analytics individually before saving
userStory.so: I can give informed, granular consent and revisit my choices anytime

acceptanceCriteria.title: Open from Manage preferences
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cookie banner from Story 17.2 is visible
acceptanceCriteria.then: Cookie Preferences modal opens with three sections: Essential (locked-on), Functional & Support (toggle, OFF), Analytics (toggle, OFF)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Save Preferences
acceptanceCriteria.when: user toggles categories and clicks Save preferences
acceptanceCriteria.then: savePreferences({analytics, functional}) called, cc_cookie updated, modal closes

acceptanceCriteria.title: Cancel / close without saving
acceptanceCriteria.given: the modal is open with pending toggles
acceptanceCriteria.when: user clicks Cancel, X, or presses Escape
acceptanceCriteria.then: store NOT modified, pending toggles discarded, modal closes. Overlay click does NOT close modal (PM decision).

technicalNotes: Radix Dialog primitive — focus trap, aria-labelledby, keyboard navigation
Equal visual weight for Save and Accept all CTAs (ICO PECR compliance — AC9)

stories.title: Story 17.4 — Cookie Inventory & Essentials Documentation (Auth0 SSO, CSRF, cc_cookie + placeholders)

userStory.want: to see a clear inventory of every cookie GEO sets, grouped by category, with name, provider, and purpose
userStory.so: I have informed consent (GDPR requirement) and understand what each cookie does before opting in

acceptanceCriteria.title: Essential section: 3 real rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: Settings Grid contains exactly 3 rows: APP_TOKEN (Auth0), GEO_OAUTH_REQ (OAuth2 state), cc_cookie (consent preferences)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Functional & Support section: Intercom + HubSpot placeholders
acceptanceCriteria.then: 3 placeholder rows with Inactive badge: intercom-session-*, intercom-id-*, hubspot-*

acceptanceCriteria.title: Analytics section: FullStory placeholder
acceptanceCriteria.then: 1 placeholder row: fs_uid (FullStory)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Cookie Settings link in UserMenuDropdown
acceptanceCriteria.when: they want to re-open the modal
acceptanceCriteria.then: Cookie Settings button visible in UserMenuDropdown, calls openPreferences()

technicalNotes: CookieSettingsGrid component with SectionId typed mapping

stories.title: Story 17.5 — Hybrid Write Strategy (dual cookie persistence + bidirectional adapters)

userStory.as: product engineer maintaining cross-module cookie consent compatibility
userStory.want: GEO to persist consent into both onclusive:mention:cookie-consent (360 format) and cc_cookie (Review format)
userStory.so: the user is recognized as having consented regardless of which Onclusive module reads the cookie next

technicalNotes: ABANDONED: Cross-subdomain writing to .onclusive.com not technically possible from geo.onclusive.com scope
Replaced by simplified approach in GEO-327

acceptanceCriteria.title: UI language fr -> French copies

stories.title: Story 17.6 — Help JIT Bridge Modal "Ready to chat?"

userStory.as: GEO user who consented to Essential cookies only and clicks the Help / Chat button
userStory.want: a modal explaining that Live Chat requires enabling Intercom & HubSpot cookies, with options to either accept and start chatting OR stay private
userStory.so: I can make a granular informed consent decision at the moment I express interest in the feature

acceptanceCriteria.then: JIT Bridge Modal opens with title 'Ready to chat?' and 2 CTAs

acceptanceCriteria.title: Enable Support & Start Chat
acceptanceCriteria.when: user clicks Enable Support & Start Chat
acceptanceCriteria.then: savePreferences({functional: true}) called, only functional_support set to true, modal closes

acceptanceCriteria.title: I'd still like to stay private
acceptanceCriteria.when: user clicks I'd still like to stay private
acceptanceCriteria.then: no store change, JIT modal closes, Privacy Fallback Modal (Story 17.7) opens immediately

acceptanceCriteria.title: Cookie Settings inline link
acceptanceCriteria.given: description contains inline Cookie Settings link
acceptanceCriteria.then: JIT modal closes, Cookie Preferences Modal (Story 17.3) opens

technicalNotes: Modal width 480px (more compact than preferences modal 600px)
Intercom Messenger boot is GEO-243 scope — this story ships modal + store API only

stories.title: Story 17.7 — Privacy Fallback Modal "Your privacy is respected"

userStory.as: GEO user who declined to enable live chat (Functional cookies)

userStory.so: I don't feel locked out of getting help just because I declined cookies — GDPR-compliant fallback (no consent wall)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Triggered from JIT Bridge Modal
acceptanceCriteria.when: user clicks I'd still like to stay private
acceptanceCriteria.then: JIT modal closes, Privacy Fallback Modal opens immediately, no consent state change

acceptanceCriteria.title: Email link
acceptanceCriteria.then: browser opens email client via mailto:support@onclusive.com, modal stays open

acceptanceCriteria.title: No additional opt-out
acceptanceCriteria.when: they interact (read, click email, click Close)
acceptanceCriteria.then: no write to consent store — purely informational modal

technicalNotes: Email support@onclusive.com — to confirm with PM before merge (placeholder)
Can be delivered in the same PR as GEO-333 (tight logical coupling)
